The learned counsel for the petitioner made a submission that in view of the clarification issued by the respondents on 03.06.2016, the relief as such sought for in the present writ petitions did not exist.
In other words, the cause arose for the filing of the writ petitions became vanish and thus, no further adjudication needs to be entertained in respect of the grounds raised.
2.Accordingly, these writ petitions stand disposed of as infructuous.
No costs.
Consequently, connected miscellaneous petitions are closed.
